findings.description: New test method name `processFindFormTreatsPageBelowOneAsFirstPage` mirrors the production method name rather than following the BDD naming school (testing-principles.md § Test Naming: `the{Subject}Should{Outcome}`), which applies to tests written from 2026-07-31 onward. A reader cannot tell from the name alone what must be true afterward without reading the body.
findings.fix: Rename to something like `theOwnerSearchShouldTreatPageBelowOneAsFirstPage` (or `theFindFormShouldClampPageBelowOneToFirstPage`) to state the outcome, not the method invoked.

findings.description: New test constructs `new Owner()` directly as filler data for the second page entry, rather than through a factory method (testing-principles.md § Test Data Construction: 'Tests never call production constructors directly... A slice adding a test writes it behind one from the start.'). The sibling test `processFindFormSuccess` does the same, but that test predates the 2026-07-31 policy cutoff and is not touched by this diff, so it is exempt; this new test is not.
findings.fix: Wrap the irrelevant second-owner construction in an anonymous factory, e.g. `createAnOwner()`, so the reader sees which values matter.

approved_aspects: Parameterized test (@ValueSource) correctly covers both the exact boundary (0) and a value well below it (-3), matching the two failure inputs named in the bug report

Assertions verify all three observable outcomes of the fix: HTTP 200 (no more error page), correct view name, and currentPage clamped to 1 — directly falsifying the pre-fix IllegalArgumentException path
No new mock usage beyond the pre-existing MockMvc/@MockitoBean repository boundary already established by sibling tests in this file — consistent with the brief's mocking policy
Test setup follows the host file's existing MockMvc convention (when/thenReturn) matching the immediately preceding processFindFormSuccess test
Four-phase structure with blank line separating arrange from act/assert; no phase comments or narration
./gradlew test passes for the full OwnerControllerTests suite including the new parameterized cases

author: change-grader
summary: clamp owner-search page parameter to the first page

blast_radius.note: Two files in one module, six hunks, no sensitive paths: one added local plus two call-site substitutions inside OwnerController.processFindForm, and one added test method with a factory helper. The identical unfloored page minus one still exists in VetController.findPaginated (line 61) but is untouched by this diff, so it is a separate follow-up rather than reach of this change.

semantic_surprise.note: Math.max(page, 1) is an exact floor: page 1 and above is unchanged, 0 and negatives land on page 1, and no overflow path exists. Reading lines 94 to 141 confirms the raw page parameter has no surviving use after the clamp, so the repository query and the currentPage model attribute cannot diverge; the upper-bound behavior for an over-large page is pre-existing and untouched.

test_adequacy.note: The parameterized test genuinely falsifies the pre-fix code: PageRequest.of(-1, 5) throws before the mocked repository is reached, so both inputs fail against the old implementation. It asserts real observable outcomes (HTTP 200, view owners/ownersList, currentPage equal to 1) rather than restating the clamp, and covers the exact boundary of 0 alongside a value below it at -3.

reviewer_hedging.note: Round 2 closed with code-quality-reviewer and test-reviewer both approved, empty findings, and no recommendations list. The round-1 changes_requested carried two autofix, fixable test-hygiene findings (BDD naming, test-data factory), both fixed and explicitly re-approved. doc-reviewer and security-reviewer are null because the low-risk review plan scoped them out, which is expected silence, not a hedge.

scope_deviation.note: Zero build retries, zero consultations, zero design revisions: the slice never fought its triage. The diff touches only the search entry point named by the requirement and the test file covering it, with no drive-by edits to the sibling processFindFormSuccess test or to any adjacent controller.
